note: The change-risk index is fixed from the source cohort book's own question — for patients born between 1930 and 1940, the percentage that were inpatients (100 * inpatient-count / cohort-count, an inpatient being an Admission of '+').

The independent side-exposure figure for the quarterly overview — how many home-payment transactions (k_symbol 'SIPO', amount over 4000) were made on accounts held by male clients born between 1974 and 1976.
The change risk score is set as that index rounded to a whole number.

The  is taken in-scope change count from the cross-book register's own question — among players with an overall rating between 60 and 65, how many have a 'low' defensive work rate — and set the change-window uplift at 1000 per in-scope change.
The release total is the risk score plus the uplift; the escalation delta equals the uplift.
The change-window branch is decided on the risk score — 'EMERGENCY_HOLD' when the score is at least 100, 'EXTENDED_WINDOW' when it is at least 20, 'NORMAL_WINDOW' otherwise

The review is booked conflict-free on business days: a 30-minute event in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest weekday slot at/after the change window's end that does not overlap any of your other events.
